text:
ravi: Heads-up: exec wants a short battlecard + webinar tie-in that calls out how we differ from cloud AI endpoints and pure infra vendors. Need draft for Friday.

claire: I'll take the battlecard. Quick structure idea: 1) 30s opener (customer pain) 2) 6 quick rebut bullets vs managed cloud 3) 4 infra vendor pitfalls 4) talking points + demo script.

toni: For the opener: use customer quote style: 'We burned budget on unpredictable inference.' Short and emotional. That sells the 'predictable' angle.

marco: Rebut bullets (short): - predictable p95 latency across traffic patterns - per-route routing & fallbacks - built-in prefix/KV cache to cut per-token work - deployment parity: same API Hosted/Dedicated/Private - ops-grade tracing and cost attribution.

beau: Add a single-line competitor comparison table in the appendix: columns = control, latency SLO, cost visibility, private deploy. Avoid naming vendors; use categories: Cloud API, Managed Endpoint, Infra-only.

claire: For infra vendor pitfalls: 1) surface-only endpoints (no canary rollouts) 2) ops tooling gap (no per-route SLOs) 3) no built-in eval/quality regressions. Keep each 12 lines.

ravi: Webinar narrative: 20m product + 10m demo + 10m customer example / Q&A (40m). Live demo: show a bursty convo workload, show routing to Dedicated then fallback to Hosted; reveal token-cost table live. Need staging demo from infra by Thurs.

deploy-bot: deploy: demo-canary deployed to staging-03 at 2025-10-15T16:04Z :white_check_mark: Warmup complete.

toni: Marketing hooks for emails: A) 'Stop guesswork in LLM serving' B) 'Same API across Hosted, Dedicated, Private' C) 'Keep latency promises, even under load' D) 'See unit-costs you can act on' — we'll test A vs D.

marco: SDR quick-call opener (15s): 'Hi, we help teams cut inference surprises and lower unit costs while keeping output quality. Quick question: what's your 95th pctl latency target?'

beau: Routing rule idea: inbound with >50k sessions/mo or >$25k cloud spend => AE stack; otherwise SDR nurture. Also tag leads who click 'download benchmark' for immediate follow.

claire: Bench narrative: be transparent: show workload profile, seq length, concurrency, model family, quant level. Include small methods appendix: how we measured caching and batch policies. No explicit multiplier claims without research sign-off.

ravi: Add 2 short battlecard TL;DRs: one for SDRs (3 bullets) and one for AEs (7 bullets + rebut scripts). We'll prioritize AE-ready content for enterprise calls.

toni: Content deadline: internal review by Thurs EOD, legal sign-off Friday AM. I'll own the slide deck.

marco: Demo checklist (for ops): - seed cache with representative prefixes - run 5x burst tests at 90/95/99th concurrency - capture token breakdown CSV - enable tracing flags - confirm fallback path works.

beau: Also prepare an edu note on 'when to pick Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted' with one-sentence rationale each (cost predictability, air-gapped compliance, fastest TTV).

ravi: Great. Action items: claire battlecard draft by Wed; toni slides + email hooks by Wed; marco demo run Thu; beau lead routing rules to ops; ravi consolidate and send to legal Thurs. Meeting 11am PT Wed to review.

claire: Cool. I'll leave inline comments in the draft and add short rebut scripts for the top-3 competitor claims.

toni: :rocket:
